comparison.objective: Lift one tightly packed toilet roll by its core and place it upright in a bin.
comparison.physical_skill: Internal expanding grasp and vertical extraction without displacing neighbors.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one roll ends upright in the bin, released and still, with neighbor damage or displacement penalized.
comparison.reason: Packed-core extraction has no adjustable mechanism, countertorque, or retained functional-cycle test.
